messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the **federal holidays** that create “long‑weekend” stretches in Canada during 2023.  
(If you’re looking at a specific province, you’ll need to add that province’s own holidays—e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-------------|-------------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sunday | **Jan 1–3** (Sun–Tue) |
| Family Day (BC, AB, ON, SK, MB, NB, PE) | Feb 20 | Monday | **Feb 18–20** (Sat–Mon) |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Friday | **Apr 7–9** (Fri–Sun) |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Monday | **May 20–22** (Sat–Mon) |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 | Saturday | **Jun 30–Jul 2** (Fri–Sun) |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Monday | **Sep 2–4** (Sat–Mon) |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Monday | **Oct 7–9** (Sat–Mon) |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Monday | **Dec 23–25** (Sat–Mon) |

> **Note:**  
> - **Remembrance Day** falls on Thursday, Nov 11, so it doesn’t form a long weekend unless you observe it on the following Friday (Nov 12).  
> - **Boxing Day** (Dec 26) is a Tuesday, so it also doesn’t create a long weekend.  

Feel free to plug this table into your holiday‑planning app! If you need province‑specific holidays or want to see how the dates shift each year, let me know.
